proof: Post one finished job, start to end
Pick a job you are proud of. Share three photos: the problem, your work, the result, with one plain line under each. Use only photos you have permission to share.
found: Name the five jobs you want to be called for
Open your Google Business Profile and list your five most wanted services, each with one sentence and a suburb you actually work in.
team: Turn missed jobs into a training plan
Write down every job your team turned away last quarter because nobody held the right ticket. That list is your training plan, in priority order.
reply: Write your three most common replies once
Save them as templates. Then aim to answer every new enquiry within one business hour, even if it is only to book a call.
